title: Freya and the Locker
author: Mirabel Delacroix
blurb: Zephyrine Ishikawa, the only out kid in a town of nine hundred, stays under the radar: head down, grades up, locker shut. Then a best friend goes missing, leaving only a set of keys behind — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must decide who to be when the labels come off, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
